standardag.name: Standard AG
standardag.desc: The minimal ruleset for Anything Goes

standard.name: Standard
standard.desc: The standard ruleset for all official Smogon singles tiers (Ubers, OU, etc.)

standardnext.name: Standard NEXT
standardnext.desc: The standard ruleset for the NEXT mod

flatrules.name: Flat Rules
flatrules.desc: The in-game Flat Rules: Adjust Level Down 50, Species Clause, Item Clause = 1, -Mythical, -Restricted Legendary, Bring 6 Pick 3-6 depending on game type.

limittworestricted.name: Limit Two Restricted
limittworestricted.desc: Limit two restricted Pokémon (flagged with * in the rules list)

limitonerestricted.name: Limit One Restricted
limitonerestricted.desc: Limit one restricted Pokémon (flagged with * in the rules list)

standarddoubles.name: Standard Doubles
standarddoubles.desc: The standard ruleset for all official Smogon doubles tiers

standardoms.name: Standard OMs
standardoms.desc: The standard ruleset for all Smogon OMs (Almost Any Ability, STABmons, etc.)

standardnatdex.name: Standard NatDex
standardnatdex.desc: The standard ruleset for all National Dex tiers

obtainable.name: Obtainable
obtainable.desc: Makes sure the team is possible to obtain in-game.

obtainablemoves.name: Obtainable Moves
obtainablemoves.desc: Makes sure moves are learnable by the species.

obtainableabilities.name: Obtainable Abilities
obtainableabilities.desc: Makes sure abilities match the species.

obtainableformes.name: Obtainable Formes
obtainableformes.desc: Makes sure in-battle formes only appear in-battle.

obtainablemisc.name: Obtainable Misc
obtainablemisc.desc: Validate all obtainability things that aren't moves/abilities (Hidden Power type, gender, IVs, events, duplicate moves).

hoennpokedex.name: Hoenn Pokedex
hoennpokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Hoenn region (OR/AS)

sinnohpokedex.name: Sinnoh Pokedex
sinnohpokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Sinnoh region (Platinum)

oldunovapokedex.name: Old Unova Pokedex
oldunovapokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Unova region as of the original Black/White games

newunovapokedex.name: New Unova Pokedex
newunovapokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Unova region as of the Black 2/White 2 games

kalospokedex.name: Kalos Pokedex
kalospokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Kalos region (XY)

oldalolapokedex.name: Old Alola Pokedex
oldalolapokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Alola region (SUMO)

newalolapokedex.name: New Alola Pokedex
newalolapokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Alola region (US/UM)

galarpokedex.name: Galar Pokedex
galarpokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Galar region (Sw/Sh)

isleofarmorpokedex.name: Isle of Armor Pokedex
isleofarmorpokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Isle of Armor in the Galar Region (Sw/Sh DLC1)

crowntundrapokedex.name: Crown Tundra Pokedex
crowntundrapokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Crown Tundra in the Galar Region (Sw/Sh DLC2)

galarexpansionpokedex.name: Galar Expansion Pokedex
galarexpansionpokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Galar region, Isle of Armor, or Crown Tundra (Sw/Sh + Expansion Pass)

paldeapokedex.name: Paldea Pokedex
paldeapokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Paldea region (SV)

kitakamipokedex.name: Kitakami Pokedex
kitakamipokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Kitakami region (SV DLC1)

blueberrypokedex.name: Blueberry Pokedex
blueberrypokedex.desc: Only allows Pokémon native to the Blueberry Academy (SV DLC2)

potd.name: PotD
potd.desc: Forces the Pokemon of the Day onto every random team.

forcemonotype.name: Force Monotype
forcemonotype.desc: Forces all teams to have the same type. Usage: Force Monotype = [Type], e.g. "Force Monotype = Water"

forcemonocolor.name: Force Monocolor
forcemonocolor.desc: Forces all teams to have Pokémon of the same color. Usage: Force Monocolor = [Color], e.g. "Force Monocolor = Blue"

forceteratype.name: Force Tera Type
forceteratype.desc: Forces all Pokémon to have the same Tera Type. Usage: Force Tera Type = [Type], e.g. "Force Tera Type = Dragon"

forceselect.name: Force Select
forceselect.desc: Forces a Pokemon to be on the team and selected at Team Preview. Usage: Force Select = [Pokemon], e.g. "Force Select = Magikarp"

evlimits.name: EV Limits
evlimits.desc: Require EVs to be in specific ranges, such as: "EV Limits = Atk 0-124 / Def 100-252"

teampreview.name: Team Preview
teampreview.desc: Allows each player to see the Pokémon on their opponent's team before they choose their lead Pokémon

teratypepreview.name: Tera Type Preview
teratypepreview.desc: Allows each player to see the Tera Type of the Pokémon on their opponent's team before they choose their lead Pokémon

onevsone.name: One vs One
onevsone.desc: Only allows one Pokémon in battle

twovstwo.name: Two vs Two
twovstwo.desc: Only allows two Pokémon in battle

littlecup.name: Little Cup
littlecup.desc: Only allows Pokémon that can evolve and don't have any prior evolutions

timerstarting.name: Timer Starting
timerstarting.desc: Amount of time given at the start of the battle in seconds

dctimer.name: DC Timer
dctimer.desc: Enables or disables the disconnection timer

dctimerbank.name: DC Timer Bank
dctimerbank.desc: Enables or disables the disconnection timer bank

timergrace.name: Timer Grace
timergrace.desc: Grace period between timer activation and when total time starts ticking down.

timeraddperturn.name: Timer Add Per Turn
timeraddperturn.desc: Amount of additional time given per turn in seconds

timermaxperturn.name: Timer Max Per Turn
timermaxperturn.desc: Maximum amount of time allowed per turn in seconds

timermaxfirstturn.name: Timer Max First Turn
timermaxfirstturn.desc: Maximum amount of time allowed for the first turn in seconds

timeoutautochoose.name: Timeout Auto Choose
timeoutautochoose.desc: Enables or disables automatic selection of moves when a player times out

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.desc: Super-fast 'Blitz' timer giving 30 second Team Preview and 10 seconds per turn.

vgctimer.name: VGC Timer
vgctimer.desc: VGC's timer: 90 second Team Preview, 7 minutes Your Time, 1 minute per turn

speciesclause.name: Species Clause
speciesclause.desc: Prevents teams from having more than one Pokémon from the same species

nicknameclause.name: Nickname Clause
nicknameclause.desc: Prevents teams from having more than one Pokémon with the same nickname

beatupnicknamesmod.name: Beat Up Nicknames Mod
beatupnicknamesmod.desc: Prevents Beat Up from revealing any party members, enforcing gameplay that assumes optimal Pokémon nicknaming strategies.

itemclause.name: Item Clause
itemclause.desc: Prevents teams from having more than one Pokémon with the same item

abilityclause.name: Ability Clause
abilityclause.desc: Prevents teams from having Pokémon with the same ability than allowed

ohkoclause.name: OHKO Clause
ohkoclause.desc: Bans all OHKO moves, such as Fissure

evasionclause.name: Evasion Clause
evasionclause.desc: Bans abilities, items, and moves that boost Evasion

evasionabilitiesclause.name: Evasion Abilities Clause
evasionabilitiesclause.desc: Bans abilities that boost Evasion under certain weather conditions

evasionitemsclause.name: Evasion Items Clause
evasionitemsclause.desc: Bans items that lower the accuracy of moves used against the user

evasionmovesclause.name: Evasion Moves Clause
evasionmovesclause.desc: Bans moves that consistently raise the user's evasion when used

accuracymovesclause.name: Accuracy Moves Clause
accuracymovesclause.desc: Bans moves that have a chance to lower the target's accuracy when used

accuracytrapclause.name: Accuracy Trap Clause
accuracytrapclause.desc: Bans guaranteed accuracy-dropping moves when used with a trapping move/ability on the same Pokémon

sleepmovesclause.name: Sleep Moves Clause
sleepmovesclause.desc: Bans all moves that induce sleep, such as Hypnosis

gravitysleepclause.name: Gravity Sleep Clause
gravitysleepclause.desc: Bans sleep moves below 100% accuracy, in conjunction with Gravity or Gigantamax Orbeetle

endlessbattleclause.name: Endless Battle Clause
endlessbattleclause.desc: Prevents players from forcing a battle which their opponent cannot end except by forfeit

drypassclause.name: DryPass Clause
drypassclause.desc: Stops teams from bringing Pokémon with Baton Pass + any form of trapping, residual recovery, boosting, or Substitute.

batonpassclause.name: Baton Pass Clause
batonpassclause.desc: Stops teams from having more than one Pokémon with Baton Pass, and no Pokémon may be capable of passing boosts to both Speed and another stat

onebatonpassclause.name: One Baton Pass Clause
onebatonpassclause.desc: Stops teams from having more than one Pokémon with Baton Pass

oneboostpasserclause.name: One Boost Passer Clause
oneboostpasserclause.desc: Stops teams from having a Pokémon with Baton Pass that has multiple ways to boost its stats, and no more than one Baton Passer may be able to boost its stats

batonpassstatclause.name: Baton Pass Stat Clause
batonpassstatclause.desc: Stops teams from having a Pokémon with Baton Pass that has any way to boost its stats

speedpassclause.name: Speed Pass Clause
speedpassclause.desc: Stops teams from having a Pokémon with Baton Pass that can boost its Speed

batonpasstrapclause.name: Baton Pass Trap Clause
batonpasstrapclause.desc: Stops teams from having a Pokémon with Baton Pass that has any way to trap Pokémon.

batonpassstattrapclause.name: Baton Pass Stat Trap Clause
batonpassstattrapclause.desc: Stops teams from having a Pokémon with Baton Pass that has any way to boost its stats or trap Pokémon.

cfzclause.name: CFZ Clause
cfzclause.desc: Bans the use of crystal-free Z-Moves

notfullyevolved.name: Not Fully Evolved
notfullyevolved.desc: Bans Pokémon that are fully evolved or can't evolve

hppercentagemod.name: HP Percentage Mod
hppercentagemod.desc: Shows the HP of Pokémon in percentages

exacthpmod.name: Exact HP Mod
exacthpmod.desc: Shows the exact HP of all Pokémon

cancelmod.name: Cancel Mod
cancelmod.desc: Allows players to change their own choices before their opponents make one

sleepclausemod.name: Sleep Clause Mod
sleepclausemod.desc: Prevents players from putting more than one of their opponent's Pokémon to sleep at a time, and bans Mega Gengar from using Hypnosis

stadiumsleepclause.name: Stadium Sleep Clause
stadiumsleepclause.desc: Prevents players from putting one of their opponent's Pokémon to sleep if any of the opponent's other Pokémon are asleep (different from Sleep Clause Mod because putting your own Pokémon to sleep is enough to prevent opponents from putting your others to sleep).

switchpriorityclausemod.name: Switch Priority Clause Mod
switchpriorityclausemod.desc: Makes a faster Pokémon switch first when double-switching, unlike in Emerald link battles, where player 1's Pokémon would switch first

desyncclausemod.name: Desync Clause Mod
desyncclausemod.desc: If a desync would happen, the move resolves to link battle behavior from the acting player's perspective. This rule covers online desyncs related to move selection, and offline disparities related to Bide and Psywave.

deoxyscamouflageclausemod.name: Deoxys Camouflage Clause Mod
deoxyscamouflageclausemod.desc: Reveals the Deoxys forme when it is sent in battle.

freezeclausemod.name: Freeze Clause Mod
freezeclausemod.desc: Prevents players from freezing more than one of their opponent's Pokémon at a time

sametypeclause.name: Same Type Clause
sametypeclause.desc: Forces all Pokémon on a team to share a type with each other

enforcesameteratype.name: Enforce Same Tera Type
enforcesameteratype.desc: Forces Pokémon to have a Tera Type matching one of their original types.

samecolorclause.name: Same Color Clause
samecolorclause.desc: Forces all Pokémon on a team to share a color

sameletterclause.name: Same Letter Clause
sameletterclause.desc: Forces all Pokémon species on a team to start with the same letter

fullarceusclause.name: Full Arceus Clause
fullarceusclause.desc: Allows Level 80 Arceus from Hall of Origin

inversemod.name: Inverse Mod
inversemod.desc: The mod for Inverse Battle which inverts the type effectiveness chart; weaknesses become resistances, while resistances and immunities become weaknesses

minsourcegen.name: Min Source Gen
minsourcegen.desc: Pokemon must be obtained from this generation or later.

omunobtainablemoves.name: OM Unobtainable Moves
omunobtainablemoves.desc: Allows special move legality rules to allow moves which are otherwise unobtainable without hacking or glitches

stabmonsmovelegality.name: STABmons Move Legality
stabmonsmovelegality.desc: Allows Pokémon to use any move that they or a previous evolution/out-of-battle forme share a type with

alphabetcupmovelegality.name: Alphabet Cup Move Legality
alphabetcupmovelegality.desc: Allows Pokémon to use any move that shares the same first letter as their name or a previous evolution's name.

sketchmonsmovelegality.name: Sketchmons Move Legality
sketchmonsmovelegality.desc: Pokémon can learn one of any move they don't normally learn.

camomonsmod.name: Camomons Mod
camomonsmod.desc: Pokémon have their types set to match their first two moves.

allowtradeback.name: Allow Tradeback
allowtradeback.desc: Allows Gen 1 pokemon to have moves from their Gen 2 learnsets

lgpenormalrules.name: LGPE Normal Rules
lgpenormalrules.desc: Tells formats with the 'gen7letsgo' mod to set the level to 50 and all Awakening Values to 0

sketchpostgen7moves.name: Sketch Post-Gen 7 Moves
sketchpostgen7moves.desc: Allows Pokémon who learn Sketch to learn any Gen 8+ move (normally, Sketch is not usable in Gen 8 or Gen 9 Pre-DLC2).

mimicglitchclause.name: Mimic Glitch Clause
mimicglitchclause.desc: Allows any Pokemon with access to Assist, Copycat, Metronome, Mimic, or Transform to gain access to almost any other move.

pomegglitchclause.name: Pomeg Glitch Clause
pomegglitchclause.desc: Allows any Pokémon from Generation 3 at level 5 or higher to have any of its level-up moves. This implementation is allowed only to enable an otherwise legal Pokémon to obtain moves it would not normally have access to at an earlier level.

overflowstatmod.name: Overflow Stat Mod
overflowstatmod.desc: Caps stats at 654 after a positive nature, or 655 after a negative nature

formeclause.name: Forme Clause
formeclause.desc: Prevents teams from having more than one Pokémon of the same forme

350cupmod.name: 350 Cup Mod
350cupmod.desc: If a Pokémon's BST is 350 or lower, all of its stats get doubled.

flippedmod.name: Flipped Mod
flippedmod.desc: Every Pokémon's stats are reversed. HP becomes Spe, Atk becomes Sp. Def, Def becomes Sp. Atk, and vice versa.

scalemonsmod.name: Scalemons Mod
scalemonsmod.desc: Every Pokémon's stats, barring HP, are scaled to give them a BST as close to 600 as possible

teamtypepreview.name: Team Type Preview
teamtypepreview.desc: Allows each player to see the Pokémon on their opponent's team and those Pokémon's types before they choose their lead Pokémon

openteamsheets.name: Open Team Sheets
openteamsheets.desc: Allows each player to see the Pokémon and all non-stat information about them, before they choose their lead Pokémon

forceopenteamsheets.name: Force Open Team Sheets
forceopenteamsheets.desc: Allows each player to see the Pokémon and all non-stat information about them, before they choose their lead Pokémon

aaarestrictedabilities.name: AAA Restricted Abilities
aaarestrictedabilities.desc: Allows validation for AAA formats to use restricted abilities instead of banned ones.

eventmovesclause.name: Event Moves Clause
eventmovesclause.desc: Bans moves only obtainable through events.

pickedteamsize.name: Picked Team Size
pickedteamsize.desc: Team size (number of pokemon) that can be brought out of Team Preview

minteamsize.name: Min Team Size
minteamsize.desc: Minimum team size (number of pokemon) that can be brought into Team Preview (or into the battle, in formats without Team Preview)

evlimit.name: EV Limit
evlimit.desc: Maximum total EVs on each pokemon.

maxteamsize.name: Max Team Size
maxteamsize.desc: Maximum team size (number of pokemon) that can be brought into Team Preview (or into the battle, in formats without Team Preview)

maxmovecount.name: Max Move Count
maxmovecount.desc: Max number of moves allowed on a single pokemon (defaults to 4 in a normal game)

maxtotallevel.name: Max Total Level
maxtotallevel.desc: Teams are restricted to a total maximum Level limit and Pokemon are restricted to a set range of Levels

maxlevel.name: Max Level
maxlevel.desc: Maximum level of brought Pokémon (if you're using both this and Adjust Level, this will control what level moves you have access to)

defaultlevel.name: Default Level
defaultlevel.desc: Default level of brought Pokémon (normally should be equal to Max Level, except Custom Games have a very high max level but still default to 100)

adjustlevel.name: Adjust Level
adjustlevel.desc: All Pokémon will be set to exactly this level (but unlike Max Level and Min Level, it will still be able to learn moves from above this level) (when using this, Max Level is the level of the pokemon before it's level-adjusted down)

adjustleveldown.name: Adjust Level Down
adjustleveldown.desc: Any Pokémon above this level will be set to this level (but unlike Max Level, it will still be able to learn moves from above this level)

stadiumitemsclause.name: Stadium Items Clause
stadiumitemsclause.desc: Bans items that are not usable in Pokemon Stadium 2.

nc2000movelegality.name: NC 2000 Move Legality
nc2000movelegality.desc: Prevents Pokémon from having moves that would only be obtainable in Pokémon Crystal.

aptclause.name: APT Clause
aptclause.desc: Bans the combination of Agility and partial trapping moves like Wrap.

nc1997movelegality.name: NC 1997 Move Legality
nc1997movelegality.desc: Bans move combinations on Pokémon that weren't legal in NC 1997.

stadiumpokecuprentals.name: Stadium Poke Cup Rentals
stadiumpokecuprentals.desc: Enforces Stadium Poké Cup Rentals legality

noswitching.name: No Switching
noswitching.desc: All Pokémon are trapped (cannot switch naturally, but can as the effect of an item, move, or Ability).

guaranteedsecondarymod.name: Guaranteed Secondary Mod
guaranteedsecondarymod.desc: All moves' secondary effect chances are set to 100% (Tri Attack and Dire Claw set a random status; Poison Touch is not a real secondary and remains at 30%).

chimera1v1rule.name: Chimera 1v1 Rule
chimera1v1rule.desc: Merges a team of six into a single Pokémon depending on the order chosen at team preview: It gains the typing of the first, item of the second, ability of the third, stats of the fourth, the first two moves of the fifth, and the last two moves of the sixth.

bonustypemod.name: Bonus Type Mod
bonustypemod.desc: Pokémon have their Tera Type added onto their current ones.

firstbloodrule.name: First Blood Rule
firstbloodrule.desc: The first team to have a Pokémon faint loses.

tiershiftmod.name: Tier Shift Mod
tiershiftmod.desc: Pokémon below OU get their stats, excluding HP, boosted. UU/RUBL get +15, RU/NUBL get +20, NU/PUBL get +25, and PU or lower get +30.

revelationmonsmod.name: Revelationmons Mod
revelationmonsmod.desc: The moves in the first slot(s) of a Pokémon's set have their types changed to match the Pokémon's type(s).

reevolutionmod.name: Re-Evolution Mod
reevolutionmod.desc: Pokémon gain the stat changes they would gain from evolving again.

brokenrecordmod.name: Broken Record Mod
brokenrecordmod.desc: Pokémon can hold a TR to use that move in battle.

forceofthefallenmod.name: Force of the Fallen Mod
forceofthefallenmod.desc: Pokémon pass the move in their last moveslot to their allies when they are KOed.

categoryswapmod.name: Category Swap Mod
categoryswapmod.desc: All physical moves become special, and all special moves become physical.

godlygiftmod.name: Godly Gift Mod
godlygiftmod.desc: Each Pokémon receives one base stat from a God (Restricted Pokémon) depending on its position in the team. If there is no restricted Pokémon, it uses the Pokémon in the first slot.

voltturnmayhemmod.name: VoltTurn Mayhem Mod
voltturnmayhemmod.desc: Every move that targets a foe causes the user to switch out after use.

convergencelegality.name: Convergence Legality
convergencelegality.desc: Allows all Pokémon that have identical types to share moves and abilities.

hackmonsformelegality.name: Hackmons Forme Legality
hackmonsformelegality.desc: Enforces proper forme legality for hackmons-based metagames.

speciesrevealclause.name: Species Reveal Clause
speciesrevealclause.desc: Reveals a Pokémon's true species in hackmons-based metagames.

franticfusionsmod.name: Frantic Fusions Mod
franticfusionsmod.desc: Pokémon nicknamed after another Pokémon get their stats buffed by 1/4 of that Pokémon's stats, barring HP, and access to their abilities.

proteanpalacemod.name: Protean Palace Mod
proteanpalacemod.desc: Pokémon become the type of the move they use.

bestof.name: Best Of
bestof.desc: Allows players to define a best-of series where the winner of the series is the winner of the majority of games.

illusionlevelmod.name: Illusion Level Mod
illusionlevelmod.desc: Changes the Illusion ability to disguise the Pokémon's level instead of leaking it.

allowedpokemoves.name: Allowed Pokemoves
allowedpokemoves.desc: Allows players to define the amount of Pokemoves allowed per set.

uniquepokemoves.name: Unique Pokemoves
uniquepokemoves.desc: Allows players to define how many times a Pokemon can be used as a Pokemove per team.

ferventimpersonationmod.name: Fervent Impersonation Mod
ferventimpersonationmod.desc: Nickname a Pokémon after another Pokémon that it shares a moveset with, and it will transform into the Pokémon it's nicknamed after once it drops to or below 50% health.

twisteddimensionmod.name: Twisted Dimension Mod
twisteddimensionmod.desc: The effects of Trick Room are always active, using Trick Room reverts the field to normal for 5 turns.

mixandmegaoldaggronite.name: Mix and Mega Old Aggronite
mixandmegaoldaggronite.desc: Causes Aggronite to no longer give the Steel type in Mix and Mega.

badnboostedmod.name: Bad 'n Boosted Mod
badnboostedmod.desc: All of a Pokémon's base stats below 70 are doubled.

datapreview.name: Data Preview
datapreview.desc: When a new Pokémon switches in for the first time, information about its types, stats and Abilities is displayed to both players.

rebalancelevels.name: Rebalance Levels
rebalancelevels.desc: Automatically rebalances each Pokemon's level if an added rule modifies its base stats in a way that only depends on its species

formats.name: [Gen 9] Random Battle
formats.desc: Randomized teams of Pokémon with sets that are generated to be competitively viable.

formats.name: [Gen 9] CAP
formats.desc: The Create-A-Pokémon project is a community dedicated to exploring and understanding the competitive Pokémon metagame by designing, creating, and playtesting new Pokémon concepts.

formats.name: [Gen 9 Champions] Random Battle
formats.desc: Randomized teams of Pokémon with sets that are generated to be competitively viable.

formats.name: [Gen 9] 1v1
formats.desc: Bring three Pokémon to Team Preview and choose one to battle.

formats.name: [Gen 9] 2v2 Doubles
formats.desc: Double battle where you bring four Pokémon to Team Preview and choose only two.

formats.name: [Gen 9 Champions] 4v4 Doubles UU
formats.desc: VGC rules, but only Pokémon that get less than 4.52% usage on the [Gen 9 Champions] VGC 2026 Reg M-A ladder are legal, as well as a few other guidelines.

formats.name: [Gen 9] NFE
formats.desc: Only Pokémon that can evolve are allowed.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Trademarked
formats.desc: Sacrifice your Pokémon's ability for a status move that activates on switch-in.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Pure Hackmons
formats.desc: Anything directly hackable onto a set (EVs, IVs, forme, ability, item, and move) and is usable in local battles is allowed.

formats.name: [Gen 9] NatDex Camove Chaos
formats.desc: National Dex-based format where Pokemon can use almost any move in the game, and their first two move types determine their type.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Monocolor
formats.desc: All Pokémon on a team must share a color.

formats.name: [Gen 9] National Dex Monoletter
formats.desc: All Pokémon on a team must have names starting with the same letter.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Mix and Mega: Limited Supply Random Battle
formats.desc: A Mix and Mega-based Random Battle made by the Pet Mods community.

formats.name: [Gen 9] CCAPM2025 Random Battle
formats.desc: A Gen 9 metagame created in the Pet Mods Room featuring Pokemon with new form changes.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Almost Any Ability
formats.desc: Pokémon have access to almost any ability.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Balanced Hackmons
formats.desc: Anything directly hackable onto a set (EVs, IVs, forme, ability, item, and move) and is usable in local battles is allowed.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Godly Gift
formats.desc: Each Pokémon receives one base stat from a God (Restricted Pokémon) depending on its position in the team. If there is no restricted Pokémon, it uses the Pokémon in the first slot.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Mix and Mega
formats.desc: Mega evolve any Pokémon with any mega stone, or transform them with Genesect Drives, Primal orbs, Origin orbs, Rusted items, Ogerpon Masks, Arceus Plates, and Silvally Memories with no limit. Mega and Primal boosts based on form changes from gen 7.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Pokebilities AAA
formats.desc: Pokémon have all of their released abilities simultaneously, as well as one ability they cannot normally use.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Shared Power
formats.desc: Once a Pokémon switches in, its ability is shared with the rest of the team.

formats.name: [Gen 9] STABmons
formats.desc: Pokémon can use any move of their typing, in addition to the moves they can normally learn.

formats.name: [Gen 6] Pure Hackmons
formats.desc: Anything that can be hacked in-game and is usable in local battles is allowed.

formats.name: [Gen 9] 1-2 Switch
formats.desc: Doubles-based metagame where each Pokémon takes turns being "active" every few turns.

formats.name: [Gen 9] 350 Cup
formats.desc: Pokemon with a BST of 350 or lower have their stats doubled.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Alphabet Cup
formats.desc: Allows Pokémon to use any move that shares the same first letter as their name or a previous evolution's name.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Bad 'n Boosted
formats.desc: All base stats of 70 and lower are doubled.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Battlefields
formats.desc: Any field condition with a set duration becomes permanent once triggered unless directly replaced, removed, or reversed. Namely, this impacts screens, weathers, terrains, room effects, gravity, and side conditions like Tailwind and Safeguard.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Bio Mech Mons
formats.desc: Items, abilities, and moves a Pokémon has access to can be put in any item/move/ability slot.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Camomons
formats.desc: Pokémon have their types set to match their first two moves.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Category Swap
formats.desc: All Special moves become Physical, and all Physical moves become Special.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Convergence
formats.desc: Allows all Pokémon that have identical types to share moves and abilities.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Cross Evolution
formats.desc: Give a Pokémon a Pokémon name of the next evolution stage as a nickname to inherit stat changes, typing, abilities, and moves from the next stage Pokémon.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Fervent Impersonation
formats.desc: Nickname a Pokémon after another Pokémon that it shares a moveset with, and it will transform into the Pokémon it's nicknamed after once it drops to or below 50% health.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Flipped
formats.desc: All Pokémon have their base stats flipped. For example, Sylveon's HP and Speed stats, Attack and Special Defense stats, and Defense and Special Attack stats swap.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Foresighters
formats.desc: Moves in the first moveslot will be delayed by two turns.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Formemons
formats.desc: Alternate formes of existing Pokemon can be used directly without required items/moves.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Fortemons
formats.desc: Put an attacking move in the item slot to have all of a Pokémon's attacks inherit its properties.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Frantic Fusions
formats.desc: Pokémon nicknamed after another Pokémon get their stats buffed by 1/4 of that Pokémon's stats, barring HP, and access to one of their abilities.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Full Potential
formats.desc: Pokémon's moves hit off of their highest stat, except HP.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Inheritance
formats.desc: Pokémon may use the ability and moves of another, as long as they forfeit their own learnset.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Inverse
formats.desc: The type chart is inverted; weaknesses become resistances, while resistances and immunities become weaknesses.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Linked
formats.desc: The first two moves in a Pokémon's moveset are used simultaneously.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Nature Swap
formats.desc: Pokémon have their stats swapped around based on their nature. A Pokémon with a Modest nature will have its Atk and Sp. Atk stats swap.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Partners in Crime
formats.desc: Doubles-based metagame where both active ally Pokémon share abilities and moves.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Passive Aggressive
formats.desc: All forms of passive damage deal type-based damage based on the primary type of the Pokémon that inflicted the passive damage against the target Pokémon.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Pokebilities
formats.desc: Pokémon have all of their released abilities simultaneously.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Pokemoves
formats.desc: Put a Pokémon's name in a moveslot to turn them into a move. The move has 8 PP, 100% accuracy, and a category and Base Power matching their highest attacking stat. Use /pokemove for more info.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Relay Race
formats.desc: The effects of the move Baton Pass are triggered upon manually withdrawing a Pokémon from battle.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Revelationmons
formats.desc: The moves in the first slot(s) of a Pokémon's set have their types changed to match the Pokémon's type(s).

formats.name: [Gen 9] Sharing is Caring
formats.desc: All Pokémon on a team share their items.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Sketchmons
formats.desc: Pokémon can learn one of any move they don't normally learn.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Tera Donation
formats.desc: The first Pokémon sent out immediately terastallizes. The other Pokémon in the party inherit that Tera Type as an additional type.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Tera Override
formats.desc: Any moves/items/abilities with mechanics relating to a specific type get that type replaced with the user's Tera type.

formats.name: [Gen 9] The Card Game
formats.desc: The type chart is simplified based off of the Pokémon Trading Card Game.

formats.name: [Gen 9] The Loser's Game
formats.desc: The first player to lose all of their Pokémon wins.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Tier Shift
formats.desc: Pokémon below OU get their stats, excluding HP, boosted. UU/RUBL get +15, RU/NUBL get +20, NU/PUBL get +25, and PU or lower get +30.

formats.name: [Gen 9] Type Split
formats.desc: The Physical/Special split is reverted; All non-Status moves are Physical or Special depending on their type, no exceptions.

formats.name: [Gen 9] VoltTurn Mayhem
formats.desc: Every move that targets a foe causes the user to switch out after use.

flatrules.desc: The in-game Flat Rules: Adjust Level 50, Species Clause, Item Clause = 1, -Mythical, -Restricted Legendary, Bring 6 Pick 3-6 depending on game type.

levelclausemod.name: Level Clause Mod
levelclausemod.desc: Changes stat calculation to depend on the Pokémon's level, which need not be 50.

healer.desc: 50% chance this Pokemon's ally has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.
healer.shortDesc: 50% chance this Pokemon's ally has its status cured at the end of each turn.

unseenfist.shortDesc: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.

slowbronite.shortDesc: If held by a Slowbro (not Galarian Slowbro), this item allows it to Mega Evolve.

belch.desc: Fails unless the user has eaten a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Once the condition is met, this move can be selected and used for the rest of the battle even if the user gains or uses another item or switches out. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one.
belch.shortDesc: Fails unless the user has eaten a Berry.

direclaw.desc: Has a 30% chance to cause the target to either fall asleep, become poisoned, or become paralyzed.
direclaw.shortDesc: 30% chance to sleep, poison, or paralyze target.

fakeout.desc: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. This move cannot be selected unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

firstimpression.desc: This move cannot be selected unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

freezedry.desc: This move's type effectiveness against Water is changed to be super effective no matter what this move's type is.

ironhead.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
ironhead.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

makeitrain.desc: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
makeitrain.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2. Hits foe(s).

moonblast.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moonblast.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

ragefist.desc: Power is equal to 50+(X*50), where X is the total number of times the user has been hit by a damaging attack during the battle, even if the user did not lose HP from the attack. X cannot be greater than 6 and resets to 0 when the user leaves the field. Each hit of a multi-hit attack is counted, but confusion damage is not counted.
ragefist.shortDesc: +50 BP/hit on user. Max 6 hits. Resets on switch-out.

saltcure.desc: Causes damage to the target equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP (1/8 if the target is Steel or Water type), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
saltcure.shortDesc: Deals 1/16 max HP each turn; 1/8 on Steel, Water.

stuffcheeks.desc: Fails if the user is not holding a Berry. The user eats its Berry and raises its Defense by 2 stages. This effect is not prevented by the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room.
stuffcheeks.shortDesc: Fails unless the user has a berry. User eats Berry, Def +2.

toxicthread.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages and poisons it.
toxicthread.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 and poisons it.
